- Cardiomegaly is noted in multiple reports, with descriptions ranging from an enlarged heart silhouette to mild or moderate enlargement.
- Pleural effusion is identified in some cases, sometimes appearing in combination with atelectasis or airspace disease.
- Evidence for lung lesions and fractures is absent as these conditions are not mentioned in the retrieved text.
